subject.title: [AI] fix(feishu): send text and voice separately for Auto-TTS replies

question: Does the July 11 live Feishu screenshot remain sufficient after the July 16 delivery-path refactor, or should exact-head live proof be required before merge?
rationale: The refactor preserves the intended semantics in source and tests but materially changes the real send path after the available live evidence was captured; Feishu is not supported by Mantis for independent proof.

options.title: Refresh Exact-Head Proof
options.body: Request a redacted live Feishu run on the current head showing both non-streamed text-plus-voice and already-streamed media-only behavior.

options.title: Accept Existing Proof
options.body: Treat the prior screenshot plus current focused delivery tests as sufficient because the latest commit is an intentional behavior-preserving centralization.

recommendation.title: Refresh Exact-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted live Feishu run on the current head showing both non-streamed text-plus-voice and already-streamed media-only behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current delivery refactor and is best positioned to confirm whether it is behavior-equivalent to the previously demonstrated implementation.
